predicates.spell_actionable: Alive, unlocked, ready, charged, affordable, valid visible target, correct ability geometry and class/rank range. BASIC has no ability-range query: derive a current-engine binding and practice rounding boundaries.
predicates.safe_regeneration_window: Missing a useful amount of HP/mana, family cooldown ready, outside own spawn, and a public cover/threat estimate supports uninterrupted recovery. A recent hit or nearby warning can invalidate it.
predicates.consumable_stock_short: At own keep, useful stack below a bounded target, actual slot/stack capacity available, and spending preserves the selected core-item and buyback budget.
predicates.one_hit_creep_window: Observed living enemy creep could be killed by the basic hit when it lands, using public HP history, distance, own attack timing and visible incoming damage. Prediction uncertainty must be measured.
predicates.xp_eligible_position: Alive and within six tiles on the correct floor when a creep dies. Distinct from maximum weapon reach.
predicates.reachable_hero_finish: Visible hero in a short, affordable damage sequence with acceptable cover, HP and retreat route; opportunity cost includes likely death, travel and forgone creepXP.
predicates.plausible_structure_finish: Nearby exposed tower/god <=two current basic hits; barracks <=one. This exact proposed cutoff is already under a separate trial, not presumed optimal.
predicates.weak_melee_productivity: Current own class has poor score support in a given role; evaluation-only class/role stratification identifies it. A live intervention must use public local threat, reach, wave opportunity and recovery inputs, not a memorized policy name or retrospective score.

belief.causal_status: Screenshots generate hypotheses; they do not show that more spending causes better scores.

verified_mechanics.kill_rewards: 150hero killXP;100building last-hitXP;500XP to every teammate for enemy-god destruction.
verified_mechanics.health_potion: 30gold,120HP over10seconds; positive incoming damage interrupts recovery. Ten-second shared health-family cooldown persists.
verified_mechanics.vitality_elixir: 75gold,90instantHP; shares health-family cooldown with the health potion.
verified_mechanics.mana_potion: 45gold,90mana over10seconds; damage interrupts. Mana Elixir costs90gold for60instantmana; same resource family shares cooldown.
verified_mechanics.inventory: Six slots, stackable consumables, own-keep shopping and no sell operation. Existing four core items + health potion + portal stack use all six slots. More item types require an explicit inventory tradeoff.
verified_mechanics.casts: Object-targeted range rejection occurs before mana/charge/cooldown spending. Merely suppressing rejected casts does not demonstrate more DPS or XP. Basic attackTarget may initiate approach; do not apply spell rejection rules to it.
verified_mechanics.creep_metric: Website last-hit XP is reward attributed at creep last hits, not a count or accuracy percentage. Nearby sharedXP is separate; current last hitter also participates in the85% share if eligible.
verified_mechanics.automatic_spells: Engine automatic casting is enabled for these bots. All200complete replays contain zero ActionManualSpells toggles across all ten actors. Failed manual range checks precede resource spending; automatic spell selection may still cast later. Prove additional effective casts or better targets before treating rejection suppression as a score intervention.

Select a valid useful spell target independently of basic attack target where appropriate; keep basic timing and defensive actions. Consider bounded retry backoff from return0 without pretending the runtime exposes an error reason.

diagnostic: Rejected commands by type/slot/reason and opportunity; accepted releases and effective damage/healing per field minute
